notes: SR4 designates identifier-2 as MOVE's receiving operand. The NEGATIVE direction was already measured (the position admits only a data reference: a literal receiver is COBOL0308, a function-identifier receiver a parse error, which is 8.4.3.2.3 SR1 holding structurally; ref-mod and subscripted receivers work; LINE-COUNTER is refused by 8.4.3.15.3 SR3). The POSITIVE direction - that EVERY legal identifier-2 is accepted - was the half that was asserted and never probed, and it was false: PAGE-COUNTER, which 8.4.3.15.3 SR1 admits wherever an integer data item may appear, was refused COBOL0899. It is now a receiving-capable place resolved at the one receiving chokepoint MoveBinder.Bind resolves each receiver through (ExpressionBinder.ResolveReceivingAtStore, kb/Work PB5386), so `MOVE 7 TO PAGE-COUNTER OF RPT1` is the golden's first line and stores 7.
